description: Convert between a coin symbol, its ENS coin type (ENSIP-9, ENSIP-11) and an EVM chain ID, e.g. 'What coin type does Base use?' (base, 2147492101, chain 8453). Give either coin or chainId. Works offline.

chainId.description: EVM chain ID, e.g. 8453 for Base

coin.description: Coin symbol such as eth, btc, sol, base or op, or a numeric coin type (ENSIP-9/11)

name: convert_coin_type

chainId.description: EVM chain ID; null for non-EVM coins

coinType.description: Coin type as a decimal string

title: Convert coin types
